run_adsorption_relaxation: run an AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_energy: calculate adsorption energy by relaxing atomic structures using an ASE calculator and LBFGS optimizer
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption relaxation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory
configure_adsorption_runner: configure an AdsorptionRunner with a custom optimizer, force convergence threshold, and max relaxation steps
relax_surface_with_adsorbate: relax both the adsorbate and bare surface together using the AdsorptionRunner relax surface option
